steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: This is phenomenal work! Ch'en snuck into an alley to save the trapped Mizuki, and followed it by directly confronting all the other competitors there.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: It seems the other teams have determined LUNG wRATh is too dangerous to keep around, and have all silently accorded to work together.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: But even so, Ch'en isn't cowed one bit, choosing to take up the fight.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: A battle to absolutely revel in!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: But we can't forget about the other side of the alley, where Lin battles too!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Unlike Ch'en's teeth-gritting clash in the alleyway, Lin's spared only a few moves to hold down the entrance, and deter any team who dares come.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Is there anyone in this whole championship who can overcome this combination's mere presence?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ha ha, goes to show they do work when they each fight their own.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, Missy, if Ch'en and Miss Lin fought, who do you think'd win?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm interested, y'know. Put two really powerful guys together, and who wouldn't wanna know who the stronger is.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Only you'd think like that!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I wouldn't know anyway. It's the first time I've seen this woman fight in years.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Huh? Weren't you and Miss Lin buddy-buddy? Weird you never got to see this.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Who's buddies with who? She plays at that mystery, 24/7. There's times she doesn't even answer the phone.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: And who says you've seen someone fight just 'cause you know them?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That's fair enough, I guess that's just me being used to Ch'en. If she wanted to win now, I'd be out of luck banking on just her swordplay.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Not everyone's got the same dynamic as you two.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Besides, it's a good thing I haven't seen it. I worry the day I do, I'll be trying to arrest her.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Makes sense. She's the Rat King's daughter, after all.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Eh, still can't say so, though. He's not a bad egg or anything.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: When I was a fresh dumbass in Lungmen...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Save it. I've met the Rat King before, you know. I don't need you telling me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, as long as you get it.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Forget that, you just used the word 'dumbass,' didn't you?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Look at me, using vulgar language in front of Milady. Oughta slap me.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: So you and Ch'en have seen how she takes fights?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: C'mon, I'm here because I haven't. Neither has Ch'en, I reckon.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're right about one thing, though. It's a good thing we've never seen her fight before. That'd put us in the tough position, we'd have to take her in.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: As long as you get it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Never thought there'd be a day when she and Ch'en work together, though.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You really do see everything as you get older.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So in the end, who do you think would win, then?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Don't feel like guessing.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Heh, then I'll guess on my own.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: In my opinion, if Ch'en had her sword, it'd be hard for Lin Yühsia to ever get near her.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But, if she does let Miss Lin get near, then Ch'en's lost.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ch'en sure sucks.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You can't say that either. Ch'en's solid with her kickboxing. Joint locks and grapples and whatever. She's amazing with all our normal training, too.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You saw how decent her accuracy was too, just now.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But in the end, Ch'en's best with a sword.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: So you're implying Lin Yühsia's as good in close-quarters as Ch'en is with her sword.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: More or less.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Having fun acting the hero, Hui-chieh?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Not really, but I don't need you worrying.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Sorry, Miss Ch'en, I...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I told you, you could've just waited over there for me. You did fine.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: Thank you for helping me out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're welcome.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: But, um, why did you do it?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No reason. I saw you, so I helped.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: I see. You're a nice person, Miss.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: And since you're nice, here.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Is this... pure gold?

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: Mhm, they were only after me because I had this.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: And you're fine giving it to us?

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: It's alright, I can go look for some more.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: Besides, I never really cared about the competition anyway. Getting to know someone as nice as Miss Ch'en is enough for me already.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'll give you a heads-up. Quite a few teams are on high alert—you can chat all you want, but you'd better not stay here too long.

steps.name: Mizuki
steps.text: I'm heading off, then. Bye-bye~

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We'd better move too.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Can I just ask, did you get anything out of that other than playing hero?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Does gold not count?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I guess.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Nothing in particular.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: So, continue? Or hand in?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We'll continue.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Alright, dear audience. I've just gotten word that all twenty pure gold ingots have been handed in.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Which means, Round 1 has reached a consummate close.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Now, then, we'll move to the voting phase.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Voting will last several hours, and once it closes, we'll be here on stage announcing the teams that made it out of Round 1! Don't miss it!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...It's over.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: There's still Round 1 voting, but with your popularity, I'm sure we'll be fine.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That said, it seems you haven't gotten leads on any dangerous terrorists, Miss Lin?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Not on my end.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Then maybe there really isn't anything to worry about.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Possibly.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Hui-chieh, do you have a moment?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: For what?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I need you for something.
